analyst_view.overall: Málaga are bottom with 5 points after five draws and six defeats, and have not won at La Rosaleda this season. Juanfran Funes calls it 'a test of persistence and resilience' and is hoping for a first win. Racing (16th, 11 points) lost 0-3 to Real Madrid and have lost all five away games. They are without Álvaro Mantilla and Andrés Martín, while Málaga have fitness doubts over Carlos Puga, Joaquín Muñoz and Pablo Martínez on top of the long-term absences.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. Racing's away record (five defeats out of five) and Málaga's need to win both point to goals. Against that, Málaga have scored only six in their last six, and Racing are without Andrés Martín, so we stay with the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 13.2 corners, already very high. Málaga should push hard at home, with David Larrubia running at defenders, but that is already in the model, and the doubts over Puga and Joaquín Muñoz could take some width out of their play.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.5 cards, raised now that Isidro Díaz de Mera has been named referee. A tense game for a winless team at the bottom fits that number, but the news gives no reason to go above it.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.9 shots. Funes expects a 'partidazo' against a Racing side that likes to play, and Racing have been open away from home. Without Andrés Martín, Racing will produce less, which balances things out.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.7 shots on target. Both defences have let through plenty of chances, which the model already reflects, and the team news does not clearly change the picture.
